launcher.notes: DEFAULT FORGE, OPTIMIZATIONS ONLY. Chunks not loading in worlds/servers and altered animations were caused by OptiFine's render rewrites. Ultra Forge 6 removes OptiFine COMPLETELY: the forge jar is now Forge 11.15.1.2318 + Kinetrix FPS Boost (MathHelper optimizer) + FoamFix memory + the crash-proof loading screen - nothing else. Chunk loading and all animations are exactly vanilla again while the FPS/memory optimizations stay. The old Ultra Forge jar in mods/ is replaced in place (size + sha256 verified, never deleted-first), the launcher no longer passes OptiFine's tweak class, and a no-op stub keeps older launchers boot-safe. Boot-verified both ways: new launcher = main menu with zero OptiFine classes; older launcher + new jar = clean boot too.

notes: Client 3.3.8 "Mirror": the cosmetics update. Scrolling no longer wrecks the cosmetics menu (grid layout root cause fixed); Capes tab shows every real cape including the animated ones; Pets show the REAL pets with their REAL names; Auras render the real ore ring / animated glows and the Spark/Storm name mix-up is fixed. Remember-me keeps you signed in between launches and a logout button sits top-right. Launcher 2.7.3 (next) bundles it.
